title: Appointment of independent non-executive directors
summary: The post Appointment of independent non-executive directors appeared first on Harmony Gold Mining Company Limited .
body_markdown:
**Johannesburg, Friday, 16 October 2026.** In accordance with paragraph 6.71 of the JSE Limited Listings Requirements, the Company hereby advises that Mr Alwyn Pretorius and Mr James Boardman have been appointed to the board of directors of Harmony (“Board”) as independent non-executive directors with effect from 15 October 2026.


The Board is satisfied that Mr Alwyn Pretorius and Mr James Boardman meet the applicable independence requirements for directors. The Board further confirms that fit and proper assessments, as contemplated in terms of the JSE Listings Requirements, have been performed in respect of both directors, and is satisfied with the outcomes thereof. In addition, the Company confirms that there are no positive statements to report in respect of the integrity information contained in their respective directors’ declarations.


Mr Pretorius is a former mining executive and qualified engineer with extensive international leadership experience. He held several senior leadership positions at Newmont Corporation, including Regional Senior Vice President for Africa and South America as well as Managing Director of Papua New Guinea. Prior to joining Newmont, he served in various executive roles at Harmony between 2006 and 2015, including Chief Operating Officer.


Mr Boardman is a Chartered Financial Analyst with experience in capital markets, private equity and corporate advisory. His career includes roles at the Johannesburg Stock Exchange, Bain & Company and private capital investment firms, bringing expertise in valuation, risk management and corporate governance.


In welcoming Mr Pretorius and Mr Boardman, the Harmony Chairman, Dr Patrice Motsepe said “We are pleased to welcome Alwyn and James to the Harmony Board. Their combined experience will further strengthen the Board’s oversight capabilities and contribute to Harmony’s global competitiveness and focus on safety, operational excellence, disciplined growth and long-term value creation.”


Ends.
